procedure: Create a clean disposable repository and fetch only the authoritative Core v29.4 tag.
Verify the annotated tag object, peeled commit, and tree against the locked inputs.
Invoke roots-replay.py replay with the exact commit/tree, manifest, materials, materials root, a new state directory, and --apply.
Require five ordered, content-addressed boundaries and no manual engine boundary.
Require owned-candidate write-tree to equal the locked candidate tree.
Generate replay-review.json and replay-review.txt from replay-state-0005.json.
Repeat from a second clean repository and compare all three evidence files byte-for-byte.
negative_gates: Reject omission of each of the five material records before candidate creation.
Reject tampered data through its SHA-256 lock.
Reject a digest-valid newly conflicting patch through Git verification.
limitations: The validation ref supplies the Core object to offline tests and is never accepted lineage.
The five engine boundaries are deterministic materialization groups; downstream-unit semantic accounting remains the separate 16-unit L3 inventory.
